status: frozen before any evidence run (freeze commit recorded in the worklog); amendments only as labelled appended entries
question: Does C3URX1 provide a source-independent, physically valid and economically useful first-gather transport mechanism under the qualified GM1 edit / source workload, and is the evidence sufficient to adopt it as the explicit development baseline?
primary_hypothesis: The benefit of preserving the exact first-gather directional radiance survives held-out conditions and provides useful end-to-end economics.
candidate: cand91.C3URX1: the WL89 C3UR relation (rel89.SendRelR, kappa_s 8, WL89 seeds) + the WL90 X1 first gather (exact once-scattered radiance per landed relation ray under the current lights), later orders by the unchanged C3UR table operator; no parameter added or tuned
preserved: WL84 ER; WL86-WL90 code, protocols, results, verdicts (imported, never edited); WL89 workloads W1 = V3, W2 = X2, sources LMIX89 / LSPOT89, references, masks, oracle tables; WL86-WL89 thresholds F1-F4; comparators R0 (WL87 EXP), C3UR (WL89), R0X1 (WL90 diagnostic, deployed draw only), ORACLE table, frozen-ER path tracing. External learned baselines: UNMEASURED (no Neural Full Recompute claim).
prior_evidence_disclosed: WL90 (inspected): C3URX1 vs C3UR on W1 T0 / T1 over the deployed draw and 16 realizations (R_mirror 0.024 vs 0.040 at T1), measured component costs. W1 is therefore a REPRODUCTION control here. Never computed before this freeze: C3URX1 on W2 (T0 / T1), under LMIX89 / LSPOT89, any pooled C3URX1, any quality ladder or end-to-end lifecycle of C3URX1.

renders.note: the WL89 / WL90 render seeds (common random numbers)

tests: tests91.py (any failure: STOPPED_INVALID_COMPARISON): T_WL90_MECHANISM (candidate = gap90 reference functions and the stored WL90 tables <= 1e-5; C3UR table = stored WL90 C3UR), T_ZERO_FINITE_NONNEG (zero light, no-visibility light), T_SOURCE_CURRENT (two lights = sum of single lights; A after B equals A; relation digest unchanged), T_RELATION_SOURCE_INDEPENDENT (no source argument in build / update), T_REPLAY, T_EDIT (null edit, selective = full incl. segments, probe buffer and table, move-and-return, stale-geometry guard raises), T_ORDER_FLUX (orders 2..5 flux within 3 % of the path-traced order fields)

fidelity_rules.per_condition: E_H / signed per region per draw against the WL89 REF-ER; gates F1 (stationary, capture), F2 (A, C_ss, R_mirror, D at T1; sharp regions gated only with >= min_pixels), F3 on the edits W1 and W2 (D, C_ss, R_mirror; resolvable only), F4 for the held-out sources (stationary <= 0.04); realization pass fraction; paired C3URX1 - C3UR differences with 95 % t intervals (16 draws)
fidelity_rules.advantage_survives: per held-out condition (W2_T1, LMIX89, LSPOT89): the paired C3URX1 - C3UR E_H interval is below 0 in R_mirror (LSPOT89, whose R_mirror mask is < min_pixels: reported, and judged on the largest sharp region with >= min_pixels)
fidelity_rules.no_harm: no region (stationary, A, C_ss, R_mirror, D) of any condition has a paired interval above 0, and C3URX1 passes every gate C3UR passes
fidelity_rules.decomposition: per condition, R_mirror: sampling = deployed / realization mean - pooled; first-gather projection = C3UR_POOL - C3URX1_POOL; remaining = C3URX1_POOL - ORACLE

economics.pipelines: e2e91.py, run alone, every pipeline executed end to end with ONE synchronised timer per event (geometry update, relation maintenance, source projection or exact first-gather evaluation incl. its probe and shadow rays, transport orders, GPU / CPU transfers, table hand-over, rendering) plus component timers; process CPU time and Dr.Jit kernel time recorded; every pipeline warmed by two untimed events of each kind
economics.kernel_compilation: pre-freeze development finding: Dr.Jit emits allocation-history-dependent variants of the same program (identical operation count, different variable order; a new Lights object or a geometry update can produce a new variant), and every new OptiX variant is compiled once (about 21 s for the path-tracing kernel, about 1 s for the table-lookup kernel). Warm event walls, ladder render walls and scaling timings therefore EXCLUDE the compilation time measured in the Dr.Jit kernel history (backend_time of kernel-cache misses), identically for all arms; the raw wall, the compilation time and the number of events with a cache miss are recorded and reported. The executed amortisation sequence is reported raw and compilation-excluded. Cold lifecycles INCLUDE compilation. The exclusion removes a cost that falls mostly on path tracing (conservative for the candidate).
economics.cold: one fresh process per arm (C3URX1, C3UR, R0, PT): scene build, material tables, relation build, probe buffer, first source evaluation, first transport, first 64-spp frame (compilation included)
economics.time_to_tier: lifecycle fixed cost (geometry-edit path, or source-only path) measured end to end + render wall to the tier by log-log interpolation of the ladder; a tier above the arm's ladder floor is NOT REACHED (no extrapolation)
economics.utility_rule: (a) no slowdown: at no tier that both reach is C3URX1 slower than C3UR by > 1.25x (edit path and source path); (b) sharp gain: in >= 2 of the 3 ladder configurations and for >= 2 of the 3 draws each, C3URX1 reaches a sharp tier (R_mirror) that C3UR does not reach or is >= 1.25x faster at one; (c) vs path tracing: >= 1.25x at every tier C3URX1 reaches, in every ladder configuration (deployed draw). SUPPORTED: a, b, c. CONDITIONALLY SUPPORTED: a and c, with (b) in exactly one configuration or with fewer draws. NOT SUPPORTED otherwise. A single favourable tier crossing in one configuration is not a general speed-up.
economics.lifecycle_rule: per-edit and per-source end-to-end cost (64-spp frame included and excluded) of C3URX1 <= 1.25 x C3UR

scaling.note: bounded, fixed; every timed operation warmed (the WL89 scaling update defect is not repeated); cost only, except the two relation-size fidelity points on W1 T1 (single draw, descriptive, not used in any verdict); no asymptotic claim

verdict_mapping.W1_REPRODUCTION: REPRODUCED iff the paired C3URX1 - C3UR R_mirror interval is below 0 at W1 T1 and the candidate tables equal the stored WL90 tables
verdict_mapping.HELDOUT_MECHANISM_VALIDITY: SUPPORTED iff no_harm holds, C3URX1 passes F1-F4 on every held-out condition with realization pass fraction >= 0.9, and advantage_survives in >= 2 of the 3 held-out conditions; CONDITIONALLY SUPPORTED iff no_harm and the gates hold and advantage_survives in exactly 1; NOT SUPPORTED otherwise (attribution: fidelity / source validity / sampling)
verdict_mapping.SOURCE_EDIT_VALIDITY: SUPPORTED iff T_SOURCE_CURRENT, T_RELATION_SOURCE_INDEPENDENT, T_EDIT pass and the end-to-end run reports selective = full and a constant relation digest across sources
verdict_mapping.BASELINE_ADOPTION_EVIDENCE: SUFFICIENT iff CANDIDATE_IMPLEMENTATION QUALIFIED, W1 REPRODUCED, HELDOUT_MECHANISM_VALIDITY SUPPORTED, SOURCE_EDIT_VALIDITY SUPPORTED, LIFECYCLE_COST SUPPORTED and QUALITY_MATCHED_ECONOMIC_UTILITY not NOT SUPPORTED; otherwise INSUFFICIENT with the failing items. Evidence statement only: adoption is the owner's decision.
verdict_mapping.FINAL_NOVELTY_EVIDENCE: not evaluated by this batch: INSUFFICIENT by scope (no external learned baseline measured, one scene family, point / cone lights)

scope: One room family; rigid edits of one S1 slab (W1 reproduction, W2 held-out); point lights and one cone light; frozen ER; 512^2; patch x 64-bin tables. No learning, no new representation, no area-light estimator, no GM2.
